title: Meghalaya: Deficit Teachers in Shillong Stage Silent Protest Over Long-Pending Grievances

ai.summary: Over 1,000 deficit teachers in Shillong staged a silent protest march demanding urgent government action on long-pending grievances, including pending DA releases and service cases, after Deputy Chief Minister Prestone Tynsong criticized teachers as 'termites'.

facts.claim: More than 1,000 deficit teachers, along with teaching and non-teaching staff, took to the streets of Shillong on Wednesday in a silent protest march organised by the Meghalaya College Teachers Association
facts.quote: More than 1,000 deficit teachers, along with teaching and non-teaching staff, took to the streets of Shillong on Wednesday in a silent protest march organised by the Meghalaya College Teachers Association

facts.claim: The march began at Don Bosco Square and proceeded towards Madan Malki, with political parties and pressure groups, including the Khasi Students' Union (KSU), joining in solidarity
facts.quote: The march began at Don Bosco Square and proceeded towards Madan Malki, with political parties and pressure groups, including the Khasi Students' Union (KSU), joining in solidarity

facts.claim: Protesters carried banners highlighting their demands for the release of pending DA, the settlement of service-related cases and the filling of vacancies in higher education institutions
facts.quote: Protesters carried banners highlighting their demands for the release of pending DA, the settlement of service-related cases and the filling of vacancies in higher education institutions

facts.claim: The demonstration also targeted Deputy Chief Minister Prestone Tynsong over his controversial remark describing teachers as "termites" (Kruin)
facts.quote: The demonstration also targeted Deputy Chief Minister Prestone Tynsong over his controversial remark describing teachers as "termites" (Kruin)

facts.claim: Through banners and placards, the protesters termed the remark an insult to the dignity, contribution and sacrifices of the teaching community
facts.quote: Through banners and placards, the protesters termed the remark an insult to the dignity, contribution and sacrifices of the teaching community

facts.claim: The teachers marched through the streets of Shillong with banners, demanding action rather than assurances
facts.quote: The teachers marched through the streets of Shillong with banners, demanding action rather than assurances

facts.claim: They warned that continued delays in addressing their grievances were undermining the interests of educators and the future of Meghalaya's education sector
facts.quote: They warned that continued delays in addressing their grievances were undermining the interests of educators and the future of Meghalaya's education sector

ai.background_note: Deficit teachers in Meghalaya have been protesting for job security and better terms since May 2026, following the state's Centralised Fund Scheme 2026 that they rejected.
